steps.en: Download the prebuilt binary for your OS and make it executable
steps.zh: 下载对应系统的预编译二进制，加上执行权限

steps.en: Copy one or more RDB dump files from Redis to your workstation
steps.zh: 把一个或几个 Redis 的 RDB 快照文件拷到工作机

steps.en: Point the show command at the dumps
steps.zh: 用 show 命令指向这些快照

steps.en: Decodes every key offline, without connecting to a live Redis
steps.zh: 离线逐个解码 key，不连任何在线 Redis

steps.en: Tallies approximate memory by data type, key prefix and largest keys
steps.zh: 按数据类型、key 前缀和最大 key 统计近似内存

steps.en: Serves the result as an HTML report on the chosen local port
steps.zh: 在你指定的本地端口上提供 HTML 报告

value.en: You learn which key prefixes eat the memory without adding a single command of load to production
value.zh: 不给生产 Redis 加一条命令的负载，就知道是哪些 key 前缀吃掉了内存

sources: https://github.com/xueqiu/rdr README "Usage" / "Exapmle" (rdr show --port default 8080, rdr keys, chmod a+x ./rdr*, ./rdr show -p 8080 *.rdb, "memory usage is approximate")
